description: Add a domain referrer scoped to a single folder. type is ALLOW|BLOCK. The new row starts in 'pending'. A folder cannot have the same hostname twice. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID where the referrer applies

hostname.description: Domain hostname without protocol, e.g. 'example.com' or wildcard '*.cliente.com'

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

type.description: ALLOW = whitelist (only listed domains play); BLOCK = blacklist (listed domains are denied)

name: panda_create_folder_refer
title: Create Folder Domain Referrer
